latest_cos_commentary.headline: Deepgram acquired drive-thru voice-AI specialist OfOne in January 2026 at a $1.3B valuation, making voice ordering a standalone competitive threat to POS-embedded voice features.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes directly with Genius's kitchen_drive_thru line where Deepgram/OfOne voice ordering can be deployed independent of the POS vendor, and can also front digital_menu_boards/kiosk ordering flows.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Deepgram is actively expanding beyond generic speech-to-text into vertical restaurant voice AI post-OfOne acquisition; expect continued drive-thru pilots through 2026.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: If a prospect mentions drive-thru voice AI, ask whether they're evaluating a standalone layer (like Deepgram) versus a POS-native voice feature, and whether containment/accuracy claims have been independently verified at their volume.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No specific named restaurant customers or pricing are publicly disclosed; containment statistics are vendor-reported and pre-date the OfOne acquisition.
